Task: Generate a Helm chart deploying a generic worker service that consumes messages from a Redis queue (Deployment, Service, ConfigMap with environment, Secret for Redis password).

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: redis-worker
description: A Helm chart for a Redis queue worker service
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"

---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Default values for redis-worker chart

# Number of worker replicas
replicaCount: 3

# Worker container image
image:
  repository: worker-app
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  tag: "latest"

# Image pull secrets
imagePullSecrets: []

# Worker service configuration
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80

# Redis connection details
redis:
  host: redis-master
  port: 6379
  passwordSecretName: redis-password
  passwordSecretKey: password

# Resource limits and requests
resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi

# Pod autoscaling
autoscaling:
  enabled: false
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 10
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80

# Node selector
nodeSelector: {}

# Tolerations
tolerations: []

# Affinity
affinity: {}

---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-worker.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "redis-worker.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  {{- if not .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  {{- end }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "redis-worker.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      {{- with .Values.podAnnotations }}
      annotations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      labels:
        {{- include "redis-worker.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      {{- with .Values.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        fsGroup: 2000
      containers:
        - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag | default .Chart.AppVersion }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ include "redis-worker.fullname" . }}-config
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ include "redis-worker.fullname" . }}-secret
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp-volume
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp-volume
          emptyDir: {}
      {{- with .Values.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}

---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-worker.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "redis-worker.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
      name: http
  selector:
    {{- include "redis-worker.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}

---
# FILE: templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-worker.fullname" . }}-config
  labels:
    {{- include "redis-worker.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
data:
  REDIS_HOST: {{ .Values.redis.host | quote }}
  REDIS_PORT: {{ .Values.redis.port | quote }}
  WORKER_QUEUE: "default"

---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-worker.fullname" . }}-secret
  labels:
    {{- include "redis-worker.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
type: Opaque
data:
  REDIS_PASSWORD: {{ (lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace .Values.redis.passwordSecretName).data.password | default (randAlphaNum 32 | b64enc) }}
